q03.

**`DB` (i.e. `postgres.DB`) — `store/db/postgres/postgres.go`**

It's declared at line 16 of that file and satisfies the `store.Driver` interface:

```16:19:/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/postgres.go
type DB struct {
	db      *sql.DB
	profile *profile.Profile
}
```

The constructor `postgres.NewDB` in the same file returns it explicitly as a `store.Driver` (`var driver store.Driver = &DB{...}`), and `store/db/db.go` dispatches to it when `profile.Driver == "postgres"`.

The interface methods are spread across the rest of the `store/db/postgres` package rather than living in one file: `postgres.go` holds the connection-level methods (`GetDB`, `Close`, `IsInitialized`, `GetDatabaseSize`), while the per-entity CRUD methods hang off the same `*DB` receiver in sibling files such as `memo.go`, `user.go`, and `attachment.go`. Note that the MySQL and SQLite drivers use the same struct name `DB` in their own packages, so the package qualifier matters here.
